clue.text: Saint has garment, something flashy

parts.note: a robe is a long loose garment

explanation.surface: A saint owns a piece of clothing that turns out to be eye-catching.
explanation.definitionFit: A strobe is a light that flashes rapidly, as at a disco or in photography.

clue.text: Dad's knocked over fluid

parts.note: Pa is Dad, and with the 's it gives PAS

clue.text: Chatterbox, not quiet — noisy type

indicators.note: not means the quiet letter is left out

parts.note: a prattler is someone who chatters on
P is the musical abbreviation for piano, meaning quiet

explanation.surface: A talker who will not stay quiet is a loud sort.
explanation.definitionFit: A rattler is something that rattles, a noisy object or person.

clue.text: Suffer in difficult situation and feel the squeeze?

definitions.meaning: read literally, being pressed hard is being squeezed

explanation.surface: Struggling in a tough spot and feeling the pinch.
explanation.definitionFit: Being hard pressed is idiomatic for struggling, and literally means being firmly squeezed.

clue.text: Race with some not quite finishing, all collapsing

indicators.note: letters that collapse fall into disorder, so these are rearranged
the word some stops short of its final letter, so it is cut before its end

parts.note: the word some, trimmed of its last letter

explanation.surface: A race in which several runners fail to finish while everyone falls over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not quite finishing' trims SOME to SOM; 'collapsing' then rearranges SOM with ALL.
explanation.definitionFit: A slalom is a downhill ski race weaving between gates, so it is one kind of race.

clue.text: Domestic container absurdly taken all over the place

indicators.note: letters scattered all over the place are disordered, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A household container ridiculously carried everywhere.
explanation.definitionFit: A laundry basket is the household hamper for clothes waiting to be washed.

clue.text: Water underground comes from toilet here

indicators.note: the answer is drawn out from within the run of letters toilet here

explanation.surface: Water beneath the floor seeps out of the toilet here.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Water underground' is a river of the underworld, not a drain.
explanation.definitionFit: Lethe is the river of forgetfulness in Hades, the Greek underworld.

clue.text: Star with money rebuilt religious community

indicators.note: something rebuilt is put together again in a new form, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A wealthy celebrity paid to rebuild a religious house.
explanation.definitionFit: A monastery houses a community of monks living under religious vows.

clue.text: Resinous substance in part of cricket field

definitions.meaning: the black sticky resin made from tar
the strip in the middle of the ground where the ball is bowled

explanation.surface: Tar-like goo turns up on the cricket ground.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the pitch is the 22-yard strip between the wickets, not the whole field.
explanation.definitionFit: Pitch names both a tarry resin and the central batting strip of a cricket ground.

clue.text: Time in good Beds town for one who indulges

indicators.note: one piece sits in another, so the time letter goes inside the town

parts.note: Luton is a town in Bedfordshire, shortened to Beds

explanation.surface: Spending a pleasant spell in a Bedfordshire town makes you a person of indulgence.
explanation.walkthrough: LUTON is a town in Bedfordshire, an English county north of London; 'Beds' is its usual abbreviation, not furniture.
explanation.definitionFit: A glutton overindulges in food or drink, so is someone given to excess.

clue.text: Girl secures ring in the end

indicators.note: the girl word holds the ring letter securely inside

parts.note: gal is informal for a girl
O is ring-shaped

explanation.surface: A girl finally gets an engagement ring.
explanation.definitionFit: A goal is an aim or end that one strives for.

clue.text: Only first three characters in college getting pass

indicators.note: only the opening trio of letters of the word college is kept

explanation.definitionFit: A col is a mountain pass, the low point of a ridge between two peaks.

clue.text: Russian who is out of this world

definitions.text: Russian who is out of this world

parts.words: Russian who is out of this world
parts.note: out of this world usually means superb; here it means literally in space

explanation.definitionFit: A cosmonaut is a Russian or Soviet astronaut, who travels beyond the Earth.

clue.text: Once again look at ornament at back of study

indicators.note: one piece comes at the back of the other, so the study word leads

parts.note: to read a subject is to study it at university
to dress something is to decorate or ornament it

clue.text: Band in street slightly indecent?

parts.note: ripe language is coarse or risqué

clue.text: Exclamation of surprise coming to distressed Indian City

parts.note: My! is an exclamation of surprise
sore means upset or aggrieved

explanation.surface: Someone gasps in surprise on arriving, upset, in a city in India.
explanation.definitionFit: Mysore, now Mysuru, is a city in the southern Indian state of Karnataka.

clue.text: Like a revolution in space travel

definitions.text: Like a revolution in space travel

parts.words: Like a revolution in space travel
parts.note: revolution here means circling a planet, not a political uprising

explanation.surface: Describing a sudden breakthrough in spaceflight.
explanation.definitionFit: Orbital describes the path of a body circling a planet, one revolution after another.

clue.text: Crazy upset brings shock

indicators.note: in a down clue upset turns the word upside down, so it reads backwards

parts.note: nuts means crazy

explanation.surface: A mad, disturbed person causes a jolt.
explanation.definitionFit: To stun is to shock or stupefy someone.

clue.text: Her co-star played in a musical group

indicators.note: letters that are played with are moved around, so these are rearranged

explanation.surface: An actress's co-star performed in a band.
explanation.definitionFit: An orchestra is a large ensemble of instrumental musicians.

clue.text: Provide food and drink in broken crate

indicators.note: something broken is in pieces, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Supplying refreshments from a smashed packing case.
explanation.definitionFit: To cater is to supply food and drink, as for a party.

clue.text: Nothing in Times for young man

indicators.note: the zero goes in the other word

parts.note: by means times in multiplication, as in four by three
O is the figure zero, meaning nothing

explanation.walkthrough: 'Times' looks like the newspaper, but it is the multiplication sign read as BY.

clue.text: Skilled worker with visual representations is a knight

parts.note: art is paintings, drawings and other visual works
taken as written
taken as written
N is the chess notation for a knight

clue.text: Cat in pool

definitions.meaning: a pet name for a cat
a shared fund of money that people contribute to

explanation.surface: A cat is found in a swimming pool.
explanation.definitionFit: Kitty is both a pet word for a cat and a shared fund of pooled money.

clue.text: Son's taken after you for sure!

parts.note: ye is an old form of you
S is the abbreviation for son; the 's is read as has

explanation.surface: A son has grown up just like you, certainly!
explanation.walkthrough: 'taken after' looks like family resemblance but places S after YE.
explanation.definitionFit: Yes is an emphatic affirmation, equivalent to certainly.

clue.text: Traffic around India produces angry outburst

indicators.note: the trade word wraps around the India letter

parts.note: to traffic is to trade, often illicitly
I is India in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Traffic congestion around India leads to an outburst of road rage.
explanation.definitionFit: A tirade is a long angry speech of criticism or denunciation.

clue.text: Stands tall when entering ship

parts.note: SS stands for steamship
